content:
The test image clearly shows:
- Angular, dark brown lesions concentrated along leaf margins
- Yellowish-green halos surrounding the necrotic tissue
- Tissue falling out leaving ragged, torn foliage
- Scattered smaller angular spots on the leaf blade

This matches Bacterial Blight perfectly. The description states: "small, angular, water-soaked spots that turn yellow and then brown... lesions may coalesce to form large, irregularly shaped lesions... Eventually lesions fall out leaving ragged foliage." The reference images for Bacterial_Blight show the same pattern of marginal angular lesions with halos and ragged tissue loss.

Frogeye_leaf_spot has discrete circular spots with reddish borders — not marginal coalescence. Downy_mildew shows diffuse chlorotic mottling. Neither matches.
